Annual and TTM revenue, net income, gross margin and operating margin come from StockAnalysis.com standardized statements (an aggregator of company filings), fetched 2026-11-13. Operating income/margin is aggregator-standardized and can exclude restructuring, impairments and other unusual items, so it may differ from GAAP operating margin (notably Intel FY2024, Broadcom FY2024, CoreWeave). Cross-check against 10-K/20-F before quoting exact GAAP margins.

Fiscal-year keys follow each company's own labels (e.g. Nvidia FY2026 ended Jan-2026); every entry carries period_end. 'TTM' = trailing twelve months to the period_end shown. Net income is net income attributable to the company as shown by the aggregator.

Non-USD reporters (TSMC, SK Hynix, Samsung, ASML, Cambricon, Huawei): USD values are conversions at the period-average exchange rate computed from Yahoo Finance daily closes, therefore status='estimate'; the reported local-currency value is in value_local.

Market cap on 2022-11-30 is DERIVED (status='estimate'): StockAnalysis year-end-2022 market cap scaled by the ratio of the 2022-11-30 close to the year-end close. Latest market caps are StockAnalysis values for 2026-11-12 (US) / 2026-11-13 (Asia). stock_change_pct is computed from Yahoo Finance split-adjusted closes, excluding dividends.

Latest prices fall in the middle of a sharp AI/semiconductor selloff (early Nov-2026: Nasdaq's worst session since Apr-2025; Kospi -6% in a day; Nvidia ~-18% month-to-date by Nov-10). Percent changes since 2022 are sensitive to the end date.
